## Privacy protections
- Replace personal importer examples and related contact fixtures with synthetic identities, reserved-domain emails and fictional phone numbers. Parsing behavior, travel formats and child ages are preserved.
- Ignore temporary login/session files, database snapshots, local backups and email attachment storage.
- Exclude attachment directories and temporary files from client source packages, including accidentally tracked files.
- Add regression checks for synthetic examples, Git ignore rules and release-package privacy.
- Preserve the application backup and meal-data settings pages when excluding runtime storage from source packages.

## Validation
Import, family/contact, settings and packaging regressions, typecheck, ESLint and an isolated production build passed.
